criteria.criterion: JiraConfig(url="http://h") raises ConfigError (InsecureUrlError) whose message contains "not 'https'", "cleartext", and "jira.allow_insecure".
JiraConfig(url="http://h", allow_insecure=True) is accepted and emits a WARNING containing "NOT encrypted".
JiraConfig() (empty url) and JiraConfig(url="https://h") are accepted without raising.
jira.allow_insecure is coerced as a bool config key (via a [tool.rebar.jira] file value) and InsecureUrlError is importable as `from rebar.config import InsecureUrlError`.

resolve_jira_settings raises (does NOT degrade to env) for a well-formed rebar.toml whose jira.url is non-https and allow_insecure is unset; a malformed rebar.toml still degrades to env; resolve_jira_datacenter_settings raises on a non-https jira.url.
write_jira_config(url="http://h") raises and writes no file; write_jira_config(url="https://h") writes; the jira-onboard wizard surfaces the error with exit 1 and no partial write.

test_cloud_config_validation.py item-2a is flipped to enforcement and its module docstring updated; DC tests (test_jira_dc_config_settings.py, test_dc_reconciler_rejects_non_https_base_url) remain green.
docs/config.md documents jira.allow_insecure (default false, env REBAR_JIRA_ALLOW_INSECURE) and the https requirement.

citation.description: All implementation files are present and syntactically complete: _config_schema.py defines InsecureUrlError and _validate_https_url, config.py re-exports InsecureUrlError, acli_subprocess.py has the InsecureUrlError re-raise, write_jira_config validates scheme, and all test files contain the required test functions. No stubs, skips, or TODOs found in the implementation. Cannot run commands directly, but the code is complete and consistent.
